name: CourtListener MCP
description: Searches US case law, PACER dockets, judges, citations, and oral arguments through a hosted MCP server over the Free Law Project CourtListener database.

skills.name: Case Law Search
skills.description: Searches millions of US court opinions by query, court, and date, returning full text with citation metadata.

skills.name: Docket Lookup
skills.description: Retrieves PACER docket entries and filings for federal cases so agents can trace litigation history.

skills.name: Citation Resolution
skills.description: Resolves legal citations to the underlying opinion and reports which later cases cite it.
